What actually blocked the mint was upheld and fixed on this branch (312b24f): a spec-amend session had renumbered the spec's declared Stories from S-34950..S-34953 to S-70904..S-70907 (docs/specs/f-0148.md's own P21), but the plan's four Task headers and two Decisions-table rows (PD5, PD6) were never updated to match, re-verified directly against both files in this checkout. Since check_doc's and phantom_stories' id scans read the whole prose of the plan, not just its Task headers, those stale ids -- naming no heading anywhere in the current tree -- are exactly the kind of citation the F-0285 guard in _mint refuses the whole plan over, which also explains why no Task has minted yet (the hold's own "Writes: (none declared)"). Fixed: every stale S-34950..S-34953 citation in docs/plans/f-0148.md is now S-70904..S-70907, matching the spec's `## Stories` section id for id. Also corrected in the same commit: PD6 independently claimed `asf.record.plan_tasks.STORY_ID_RE` is `\bS-\d{4}\b` and so could never match a five-digit id -- re-read at asf/record/plan_tasks.py:29,35 and asf/record/core.py:45, the regex is built from `ID_DIGITS = r'\d{4,}'` (four or more digits), so that claim was false on this checkout and is corrected rather than left to mislead a future reader. Nothing else about the spec or plan's design was in dispute, and no finding from a formal review round applies: docs/reviews/1-f-0148.md does not exist on this branch and none was quoted in the adjudication brief. This ends the SPEC-AMEND cycle for F-0148: no further spec-amend round is needed or should be attempted -- the next tick's plan-tasks stage mints the four Story cards and the four Task cards from the (now-consistent) landed spec and plan on its own.
